title: Fraction Addition and Subtraction
goal: Add and subtract fractions and return one reduced fraction with a positive denominator.
strategy: Fold each signed fraction into an accumulator using cross multiplication, then divide numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor. Exact integer arithmetic handles cancellation without rounding.
